text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Stateless people in Kuwait buy forged Dominican Republic passports for about $6,000 each.

- Lawyers society says parliamentary dispute should be referred to constitutional court. Former finance minister and MP Kharafi says last month's election of opposition veteran Saadoun as parliament speaker was unconstitutional.
- Kuwait denies Baghdad's claims, says Iraqi president Saddam Hussein is responsible for the suffering of his people who are living under United Nations sanctions since 1990.
- Kuwaiti economist says 58,000 expatriates expected to join local workforce by the year 2000.
- Kuwait Fund for Economic Development signs loan accord with Egypt worth 18 million dinars to finance a sewage project.
- Two telecommunications satellite stations to be commissioned soon, Ministry of Communications says.
- Finance Minister Rodhan heads to Cairo for Middle East and North Africa economic conference.
